n, k = map(int, input().split())
p = list(map(float, input().split()))

ans = [0.0] * n
dp_state = [0.0] * (1 << n)
popcount = [0] * (1 << n)

for mask in range(1, 1 << n):
    popcount[mask] = bin(mask).count('1')

dp_state[0] = 1.0

for mask in range(1 << n):
    total_prob = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        if (mask & (1 << i)) == 0:
            total_prob += p[i]
    if total_prob < 1e-12:
        continue
    for i in range(n):
        if (mask & (1 << i)) == 0:
            p_i = p[i] / total_prob
            if popcount[mask] < k:
                ans[i] += dp_state[mask] * p_i
            dp_state[mask | (1 << i)] += dp_state[mask] * p_i

print(' '.join(f"{x:.12f}" for x in ans))
